stories.title: A494 blocked in Gwernymynydd after collision, with air ambulance sent to scene
stories.summary: The A494 is blocked in both directions in Gwernymynydd, near Mold, after a collision. The road is blocked between Maeshafn Road and Hafod Road, and traffic is queueing. stories.title: Microsoft outage disrupts train tickets, Flintshire Council email and health board enquiries
stories.summary: Rail passengers who cannot open emailed train tickets, and people waiting on replies from Flintshire Council or the North Wales health board, are being affected by a global Microsoft outage. stories.title: Shotton Mill director joins new business board advising on North Wales economy
stories.summary: Jackie Pearson is one of nine members of Ambition North Wales' Business Advisory Board, which will advise on the Growth Deal and the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone.

stories.title: Councillor asks if Flintshire is “flogging a dead horse” with Warren Hall tax site
stories.summary: A Flintshire councillor has asked whether the council is “flogging a dead horse” with Warren Hall in Broughton, a site where firms could get up to five years free of business rates. stories.title: Asda cuts unleaded to 159.7p at Queensferry as supermarket takes 4p a litre off fuel
stories.summary: Asda has cut unleaded to 159.7p a litre at its Queensferry forecourt, the second cheapest petrol in Flintshire on Deeside.com’s fuel price tracker.
